newsitem.title: USA: Prudential creates commercial mortgage subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Prudential creates commercial mortgage subsidiary.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America said on Wednesday that it is creating a commercial mortgage unit to expand its real estate lending activities.

In a statement, company officials said they expect to double Prudential's annual origination volume from $2 billion to $4 billion once the subsidiary, called Prudential Mortgage Capital Co, is fully operational.

"We know this is a very tough sector with tightening margins. It will require significant economies of scale and wherewithal to meet our goal of creating a profitable long-term business," said Clay Lebhar, named chief executive of the unit.
